title: android executor
description: Copies a built Lynx bundle into an Android host project's assets and runs `./gradlew assemble<Variant>`.

lynxApp.description: Name of the Lynx (rspeedy) project whose built bundle should be embedded, e.g. "web".

bundleFileName.description: Bundle filename to look for under that project's resolved output dir.

variant.description: Gradle build variant to assemble. release requires a real signing config.

assetName.description: Filename the bundle is copied to under app/src/main/assets/. Defaults to bundleFileName.
